disclaimer: Articles posted on 'The Graticule' represent the views and opinion of the author and may not reflect the views and opinion of the editorial board, other contributors or Queen's University Belfast.
requirements: Under no circumstances can any submission be a form of defamation; submissions must NOT be false statements that are damaging to a person's or a place's reputation.
Submissions MUST be outward-looking, non-prejudicial and non-sectarian.
Submissions MUST be free of plagiarism and should be referenced using 'Harvard'.
Submissions MUST be spell-checked, fact-checked and grammar-checked.
Whilst submissions should be geography-related, it is a very diverse subject. If there's something you want to cover but you're not sure if it would work - contact us!
